content: For a certain encoding INLINEFORM0 the sequence-to-sequence model should define a probability distribution over different sequences. By sampling from this distribution the NUS can generate a diverse set of sentences corresponding to the same dialogue context. The conditional probability distribution of a length INLINEFORM1 sequence is defined as: DISPLAYFORM0
